values.title: Origin
values.titleText: Choose where your traveler grew up.

values.title: Orbital station
values.text: You grew up in a dense artificial habitat with reliable services.

values.title: Frontier settlement
values.text: You grew up in a small settlement where repairs and self-reliance were routine.

values.title: Specialty
values.titleText: Choose your main field of training.

values.title: Engineer
values.text: You can maintain machinery and diagnose common technical failures.

values.title: Scout
values.text: You are trained in navigation, field observation, and route planning.

values.title: Optional gear
values.titleText: Spend any remaining points on extra equipment.

values.title: Repair drone
values.text: A compact maintenance drone assists with routine mechanical work.

values.title: Survey kit
values.text: Portable mapping and environmental sensors help with field work.
